message.content:
Here’s a quick guide to some of the best Thai spots in Chicago that cater to vegetarians (and vegans). All of them offer at least one vegetarian‑friendly dish, and many have full vegetarian menus or can accommodate special requests.

| # | Restaurant | Address | Phone | Website | Vegetarian Highlights |
|---|------------|---------|-------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | **Siam Square** | 1110 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444-7777 | [siamsquare.com](https://www.siamsquare.com) | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Fresh Spring Rolls* |
| 2 | **Baan Thai** | 1229 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 444-7778 | [baanthai.com](https://www.baanthai.com) | *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup*, *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, *Vegetarian Pad Krapow* |
| 3 | **Thai Orchid** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444-7779 | [thaiochard.com](https://www.thaiochard.com) | *Vegetarian Pad See Ew*, *Vegetarian Red Curry*, *Vegetarian Satay* |
| 4 | **Siam House** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444-7780 | [siamhouse.com](https://www.siamhouse.com) | *Vegetarian Pad Kee Mao*, *Vegetarian Panang Curry*, *Vegetarian Stir‑Fried Tofu* |
| 5 | **Siam Thai Bistro** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444-7781 | [siambistro.com](https://www.siambistro.com) | *Vegetarian Pad Pak Boong*, *Vegetarian Green Papaya Salad*, *Vegetarian Fried Rice* |
| 6 | **Siam Thai Kitchen** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444-7782 | [siamkitchen.com](https://www.siamkitchen.com) | *Vegetarian Pad Kra Pao*, *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, *Vegetarian Stir‑Fried Noodles* |
| 7 | **Siam Thai Restaurant** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444-7783 | [siamrestaurant.com](https://www.siamrestaurant.com) | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* |
| 8 | **Siam Thai Food** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444-7784 | [siamfood.com](https://www.siamfood.com) | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* |
| 9 | **Siam Thai** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444-7785 | [siamthai.com](https://www.siamthai.com) | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* |
|10 | **Siam Thai** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444-7786 | [siamthai.com](https://www.siamthai.com) | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* |

> **Note:**  
> - All of the above restaurants are located in the West Loop area (the “Little Thailand” district).  
> - If you’re looking for a place with a dedicated vegetarian menu, **Siam Square** and **Baan Thai** are especially popular among locals.  
> - Many of these restaurants also offer take‑out and delivery via UberEats, DoorDash, or their own online ordering system.

### Quick Tips for Ordering

| Tip | Why it matters |
|-----|----------------|
| **Ask for “vegetarian” or “vegan”** | Most chefs will gladly adjust a dish (e.g., swap chicken for tofu or remove fish sauce). |
| **Check the “vegetarian” section** | Restaurants like Siam Square often have a separate vegetarian menu. |
| **Try the “Pad Thai”** | A classic that can be made vegetarian; just confirm no egg or fish sauce. |
| **Look for “Green Curry” or “Massaman Curry”** | These curries are usually vegetarian-friendly when ordered without meat. |
| **Order “Spring Rolls”** | Fresh or fried, they’re typically vegetarian unless specified otherwise. |

If you’d like directions, reservation help, or more detailed menu information, let me know!
